metadata.title: Alberta provincial design-flood hazard mapping near four Calgary communities

params.where: Flow_Regime IN ('Regulated','Natural') AND Multi_Zone NOT IN ('1:200 Flood','1:500 Flood')

metadata.includedScenarios: Design-flood zones with Flow_Regime Regulated or Natural. Excludes Naturalized comparison scenarios and incremental 1:200/1:500 zones.
metadata.floodScenario: 1:100 design flood; modelled hazard extent, not an individual property loss probability.

studyVintage.Bow and Elbow River Flood Study: Finalized May 15, 2025; the provincial study page says regulated flows account for Springbank Off-stream Reservoir and Glenmore Dam downstream where applicable.
studyVintage.Nose and West Nose Creek Flood Hazard St: Original study completed June 2005; hydraulic levels revised July 2012 without changing flood-hazard mapping, according to the provincial study page.

metadata.caveat: Provincial flood-hazard evidence is distinct from Calgary municipal regulatory designations. The City’s June 2026 update says proposed regulatory map and bylaw amendments were deferred for additional engagement. Do not label this layer the adopted City regulatory map.
metadata.geometryProcessing: All 342 qualifying intersecting source feature IDs reconciled with the complete attribute query. Source geometry requested in Web Mercator with 5m generalization, converted to WGS84, clipped to four communities and an approximate 400m buffer, then simplified at 0.00002 degrees for display. Not suitable for exact parcel-boundary or elevation decisions.

geometryAudit.explanation: Six generalized interior rings could not be assigned to an exterior ring; all were verified disjoint from the delivered region before exclusion, so they cannot alter the local clipped geometry.
